scripts.test:server: tsx --test server/httpAuth.test.ts server/httpRoutes.test.ts server/wsHandler.test.ts server/RollbackManager.test.ts server/utils/buildCommand.test.ts
scripts.build: npm run typecheck:server && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.package:server: npm run build:server && cp -r server/prompts server/skills dist/server/ && cd dist && tar czf server.tar.gz server/ && echo "\n✅ 打包完成: dist/server.tar.gz"
scripts.package:server:zip: npm run build:server && cp -r server/prompts server/skills dist/server/ && cp server/models.json dist/server/ && cp package.json dist/server/ && cd dist && cp -r ../node_modules node_modules && tar czf server.tar.gz server/ node_modules/ && rm -rf node_modules && echo "\n✅ 离线部署包完成: dist/server.tar.gz (含 node_modules)"
scripts.package:full:zip: npm run build && npm run build:server && cp -r server/prompts server/skills dist/server/ && cp server/models.json dist/server/ && cp package.json dist/ && cd dist && cp -r ../node_modules node_modules && tar czf full.tar.gz . && rm -rf node_modules && echo "\n✅ 全量离线部署包完成: dist/full.tar.gz (含前后端 + node_modules)"
